pages.text: After killing those high ranking $(l:world/bestiary/minister)illagers$(), you've managed to procure their powerful orb and use it to make a replica of their staff.
The Ominous Staff powers up certain magical spells. Vexing, Biting, Feasting, Shredding and Teeth spells to be precise. Casting Rotting and Osseous spells summons undead illagers instead.
